<script>
(function(){
  var es = new EventSource("/ospf/database/stream");
  es.addEventListener("database", function(e){
    var el = document.getElementById("ospf-data");
    el.textContent = e.data;
  });
  window.addEventListener("beforeunload", function(){ es.close(); });
})();
</script>
</body></html>
